verdict.rationale: Linear's developer docs explicitly publish per-auth-type rate limits (API key, OAuth, unauthenticated), leaky-bucket refill behavior, complexity limits, and rate-limit response headers, giving AI-native builders concrete numbers to design automation around. Missing for 10: explicit documented concurrency caps (max simultaneous requests/connections) beyond hourly request quotas, and no independent/hands-on confirmation that these limits hold in practice at scale.
